evidenceKind: Read-only installed Unity material extraction, D3D11 bytecode disassembly, and published GLB comparison; original game bytecode/images are not included in this report.

compiledEvidence.finding: Input TEXCOORD0 v3 is copied to output TEXCOORD3 o4; the pixel shader receives it as v4. BaseTexture coordinates are mesh UV0.
t3 is _BaseTexture; cb3[4] is _BaseTexture_ST; cb3[3] is _BaseColor; cb3[31].x is _BaseTexAmount. The shader applies UV0*ST.xy+ST.zw and computes base=BaseColor*mix(1,BaseTexture.rgb,BaseTexAmount).
The top branch independently blends TopColor/TopColor1/TopColor2 using TopTex/TopTex2 masks, then multiplies by Tint. BaseTexture does not multiply this branch.
Top blend uses world-normal Y (or local direction when enabled), sampled TopColorMaskTex.r*TopColorTexInfuence, TopColorRemap and TopColorAmount.
Independent bottom and top branches are combined by lerp(bottom,top,topAmount); M_Forest_rock TopColorShadowAmount=0 makes the intervening base attenuation 1.

bug: The viewer multiplied BaseTexture.rgb by the entire mix(BaseColor,TopColor,amount). This incorrectly retained UV0 texture detail on the top-color surface.
repair: Keep BaseTexture UV0/ST sampling. Multiply its sample into the base branch, then blend that textured base with the independent top-color branch.
limits: The shader bytecode audited here is installed build 25739797. Published build 25306743 shader bytecode was unavailable; its base/top color values and BaseTexture pixels match exactly, but bytecode identity across builds is not claimed.

The viewer still approximates Texture1/2/3 layers, TopTex/TopTex2 masks, TopColorMaskTex, hue shifts, Tint and game lighting. This repair corrects BaseTexture/top compositing without claiming full shader parity.

Installed W/Peak_Rock uses TopColorRemap [0.5579954385757446,0.7692307233810425]. Saved TopSurfaceTightness and UseTopColor are undeclared legacy fields; exported slope metadata remains an approximation.
